---
name: Feature request
about: An idea that would make a step of your branch-to-release flow easier
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?** (the situation first, then the idea)

**How do you do it today?**

**What would you like git shuttle to do?** (a command, a screen, or a setting; a sketch is welcome)

**Anything it must never do?** (git-shuttle never forces a push, never commits to a protected branch, and always previews first)
